notes.title: The Final? Update! + Simplified Chinese!
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone![/b]

We gathered some really good feedback over the past few months since Chronicle's 2.0 release and we're happy to bring a major update reworking and fixing a ton of bugs and content!

Patch notes below!

[h2]ADDITIONS[/h2]
[list]
[*] New Translations! -> [b]Simplified Chinese![/b]
[*] Nano and Nina have a new attack!
[*] ---> Full barrage of indestructible bullets.
[*] Added a "Laser Pickup Required" message if you fire your laser without the laser powerup.
[*] Added a "Mouse Only" option in Game Settings where you can play the entire game with your mouse!
[*] Added new achievements.
[*] Language now can be chosen on the first time you load the game.
[*] Added a 3 second countdown delay to picking traits so you do not pick the wrong one on accident.
[*] You now receive a Trait Drop every 2 bosses killed in Boss Rush.
[*] Added a visual slider to the Dodge Roll to better understand the length of the cooldown.
[*] Added a wave number in Boss Rush's pause mode to see how far you are from the last wave.
[/list]

[h2]ADJUSTMENTS[/h2]
[list]
[*] Nina's launch off speed to initiate her bomb drop attack is 30% faster.
[*] All minibosses now fly offscreen and de-spawn when you move to a side lane.
[*] Updated Russian font to fit the game better.
[*] Challenges now scale in XP (+25 XP per Ship Level).
[*] Boss Rush wave level scaling now increased by 3 per boss down from 5.
[*] Bob's Drones no longer drop powerups or health packs in Boss Rush.
[/list]

[h2]FIXES[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed Russian translation errors.
[*] Fixed an issue where "Helping Hand" turrets do not rotate around you after trait level 1.
[*] Fixed a bug where Nano becomes untargetable if he joins together with Nina while Nina dies.
[*] Fixed a bug where Side Flying Drones would sometimes have transparent bodies.
[*] Fixed an issue where Traits that were Lvl 2 and higher were not displaying information correctly.
[*] Fixed an issue in the math algorithms for Traits Lvl 2 and higher.
[*] Fixed an issue where "Reinforced Forge" had an incorrect description.
[*] Fixed a bug where starting a new run from The Grid opens the options menu instead of the Start Run menu on default.
[*] Fixed a bug where all Bomb Drones had their missile targeter always on.
[*] Fixed sprite sorting and drawing issues for the Base Defense System.
[*] Fixed bug where Killchain counter in Arcade mode was breaking the entire level.
[*] Fixed a silly bug where none of the Dialog Voices were using the Dialog Volume Control.
[*] Fixed a bug where dialog was not playing for the Base Approach cutscene.
[*] Fixed a bug where picking the "Bomb and Take" trait was breaking the game on the next trait drop. 
[*] Fixed a bug where killing Fionne too fast broke the game.
[*] Fixed a bug where Bosses were not using their correct healthbars in Boss Rush.
[/list]

We're really excited to announce the next couple of projects that we're working on!

Don't forget to follow us on Twitter for updates -> [url=http://twitter.com/staticcitygames]http://twitter.com/staticcitygames[/url]

We'll talk to you soon!

- Josh
- Static City Games

notes.title: Chronicle 2.0! Major Update / Re-Release!
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone![/b]

It's been a hot minute since we've said anything on here. 

Chronicle just launched a massive update changing a lot of the base game and we also added a ton of new content. Check out the patch notes below for ALL of the changes!

[h1]Additions[/h1]
[list]
[*] Dead co-op players now respawn before the final stage.
[*] Controller D-Pad now works.
[*] All controllers now have support.
[*] Menus can now be navigated via the D-Pad on controllers.
[*] White flash added to the laser recharger for a visual cue when the laser is ready to be used.
[*] Sound added to the laser recharger on ready use.
[*] Weapon drop odds reduced 8% -> 1% + 0.5% per missed drop.
[*] All bosses and midbosses now strafe.
[*] Some enemies can have armor and will flash blue instead of white.
[*] B button now allows for back to grid from the menus.
[*] All damage sources now show damage numbers.
[*] New start run screen in The Grid.
[*] The Grid's menu dots now flash red when something new exists in that section.
[*] Asteroids have been reworked and re-animated.
[*] Load game screen now shows your current ship level and highest completed difficulty.
[*] Pause menu shows current game mode.
[*] Added tutorial to challenges section for clarity.
[*] New mid-game cutscene added.
[*] New Voice Over for Operator 27.
[*] New Voice Over for Unit Eight's computer.
[*] Arcade mode now has multiple different voice lines.
[*] New achievements have been added.
[*] Death defy now shows as a notification when it triggers.
[/list]

[h2]Powerups![/h2]
We've added a handful of powerups that drop more often than weapons to assist you against the constant barrage of enemies and bullets. Powerups expire after set amounts of time.
[list]
[*] 2x Damage - Increase all damage output by 2x.
[*] 3x Damage - Increase all damage output by 3x.
[*] Auto Fire - Constant fire without holding down the fire buttons.
[*] Max Fire Rate - Increased your fire rate to the max perk level.
[*] Ammo Crate - Gives a free pickup of all current ammo-containing weapons.
[*] Shield - Adds a player shield that blocks the first instance of damage.
[*] Bullet Reflector - Enables your reflector that ricochets bullets back at enemies using their damage.
[*] Homing Bullets - Turns your bullets into precision death bullet machines.
[/list]

[h2]Multi-Lane Room System![/h2]
To give the game more of a roguelike feel, Chronicle now has 3 separate lanes that exist. The side lanes can be switched to at various times through the level and have different bonuses attached to completing those rooms. The enemies in this side rooms have increased health and damage.

[list]
[*] Health - Increases max health by 20%.
[*] Weapon - Grants a weapon and increased damage output by 10%.
[*] Scraps - Grants a whole mess of scraps.
[*] Bombs - Grants extra bombs and increases bomb damage output.
[*] Trait Star - Grants an increased rarity trait.
[/list]

[h2]Traits![/h2]
Roguelikes typically have ways to modify the gameplay to make each run unique. Chronicle has 31 different traits that can spawn after a side lane and after a boss.
Your current Traits are always visible from the Pause Menu and you can not have more than 9 different traits.

[h2]New Perk Nodes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Starting Shield - Starts each run with the shield powerup.
[*] Starting Trait - Adds a % chance to start a run with a trait drop selection.
[*] Unlock Double Fire - Adds the double fire weapon into the drop system.
[*] Unlock Double Angled Fire - Adds the double angled weapon into the drop system.
[*] Unlock Upgraded Sideshot - Adds the upgraded sideshot weapon into the drop system.
[/list]

[h2]Ascensions![/h2]
[list]
[*] After completing the Standard game mode, you can now unlock ascension levels.
[*] Ascensions are the standard game mode with more factors / rules added in to increase the difficulty drastically.
[/list]

[h2]New Boss Abiltiies and Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Bob
[*] ---> Burst Fire when shield get broken or shield returns to normal after healing.
[*] ---> Bob Drones now spawn with every attack starting at 50% HP.
[*] ---> Total bob drones on screen increased from 4 -> 5
[*] ---> Decreased Bob's cooldown between attacks from 3.5 sec -> 3 sec
[*] Logan
[*] ---> Bomb that confused player movement controls.
[*] Fionne
[*] ---> Bomb that explodes into shrapnel in 360 degrees.
[*] ---> Fionne's buzzsaws move 20% faster
[*] Nano & Nina
[*] ---> Attached now track player and fire a massive laser.
[/list]

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[i]Chronicle was initially was too slow to be classified as a bullet hell, so we've made some changes to the player's stats and systems to make it feel like it's settled into it's niche.[/i]

[list]
[*] Initial Bullet Attack Cooldown reduced from 0.3 sec -> 0.15 sec (faster initial fire rate)
[*] Fire Rate per level perk reduced from 2.5% -> 2%
[*] Initial Bullet Speed increased from 6.5 units/sec -> 8.75
[*] Initial Missile Fire Rate reduced from 0.58 sec -> 0.445 sec
[*] Initial Player Movement Speed increased from 5.5 units/sec -> 6.15
[*] Players now start with 3 weapons, basic shot, single angled shot, sideshot. Can pickup empowered version of each of these weapons which have an ammo count.
[/list]

To compensate for the player buffs, we've also buffed stats across the board for enemies.

[list]
[*] Basic enemy drones now attack faster from 0.75 sec -> 0.6 sec
[*] All enemy default bullet speeds increased from 5.85 units/sec -> 7.85 units/sec
[*] Turret bullet speed increased from 5.95 units/sec -> 7.85 units/sec
[*] Bob's drones bullet speed increased from 3 units/sec -> 4 units/sec
[*] Bob's elites bullet speed increased from 4 units/sec -> 6.25 units/sec
[*] Zelos - all forms - bullet speed increased from 5 units/sec -> 6.75 units/sec
[*] Base Defense System bullet speed increased from 5 units/sec -> 6.25 units/sec
[*] Fionne, Logan, Nano & Nina, and Tetraknights bullet speed increased from 4 units/sec -> 6 units/sec
[*] Ground Mech bullet speed increased from 6 units/sec -> 7 units/sec
[*] Enemy health calculations reworked to be less exponential and feel more fair.
[/list]

[list]
[*] On a new run, enemies now start spawning 1 second faster from 3.5 sec -> 2.5 sec after player flies in.
[*] Reduced enemy spawn interval speed from 1.75 sec -> 1.05 sec
[*] Reduced time waiting between waves from 5.5 sec -> 0.25 sec
[*] Increased chance of two enemies spawning at the same time from 10% -> 25%
[*] Increased chance of three enemies spawning at the same time from 3% -> 6.5%
[*] Tweaked the color of the back button in the New and Load Game menus to better show when it is selected.
[*] Pausing in story mode is now instant and does not have a wait buffer.
[*] Removed moving around The Grid during zoom out.
[*] Missiles have been reworked.
[*] ---> Missile weapon is now the Missile Barrage.
[*] ---> Missiles now auto target enemies.
[*] ---> The missile fire rate perk is now Total Missile Targets (up to 16 missiles can be fired at once)
[*] ---> Turning speed improved.
[*] Nina now targets and tracks the player faster during her laser attack.
[*] Increased loading screen bullet speed.
[*] Modified asteroid explosion sound.
[*] Added sounds in selection screens.
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] "Defy Death" perk could activate when you choose to End Run from the Pause Menu, which would not end your run.
[*] Fixed a bug where you could scroll between menu screens when the stats screens were open.
[*] Fixed a bug where Pulse Blast ammo was consumed as fast as regular weapons.
[*] Fixed an issue where The Tetraknights would fire missiles from empty voids.
[*] Fixed a co-op issue where reaching Zelos with a dead second player stops you from advancing to the final level. 
[*] Fixed a bug where hitbox was larger than intended for player collisions.
[*] Fixed a bug where Tetraknight Gren's vines would persist after he exploded.
[*] Fixed a sorting issue where Weapons and Scraps were not sitting above all objects for easy visibility.
[*] Fixed a sorting issue where Players were not sitting above all objects for easy visibility.
[*] Fixed a bug where the game would not progress is Nano died too fast before Nina.
[*] Fixed localization issues in The Grid.
[*] Fixed an issue where Vine attacks would not update when the boss strafes.
[*] Fixed a bug where The Tetraknights would not attack immediately in Boss Rush.
[*] Fixed a bug where Nina would spawn in the wrong animation state in Boss Rush.
[*] Bosses no longer bounce backward when taking damage.
[*] Fixed a bug where skipping too quickly through cutscenes would break them.
[*] Fixed a bug where The Grid would say you were about to play a Boss Rush mode but ended up in Standard.
[*] Bosses no longer move horizontally off camera.
[*] Fixed a bug where Drill Drones sometimes would not attack.
[*] Removed challenge rewards line from Boss Rush end screen.
[*] Fixed a bug where Fionne's buzzsaws would disappear if only one left the top of the screen.
[*] Fixed Background in main menu for controls screen.
[*] Added loading screen after company logos to fix the black screen issue.
[*] Fixed a bug where tutorials would break boss cutscenes.
[*] Fixed controller navigation in load game screen.
[*] Fixed a bug where beating the game would grant you 5 ship levels.
[*] Fixed a bug where players would sit above blast doors inside the ship.
[*] Fixed Gren's warning vines to update with his movement.
[*] Fixed a bug where you could not re-select the pause menu after alt-tabbing.
[/list]

We hope you love the new Chronicle as much as we do!
Here's to an excellent rest of the year!

Much love,

Static City Games

notes.title: 1.2.0 - The Survivability Update - This Gon' Be Good
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Remember when these were every week? It's starting to feel like that.

The game in it's current state is not forgiving and really makes you hate playing it. We're here to fix that in this update.

[h2]ADDITIONS[/h2][list]
[*] Speedboost powerups now grant invincibility for 1 second (roughly 30% of the full duration of the boost) on pickup!
[*] Scraps now auto-collect if on screen when you reach a boss.
[*] Added controller configurations for Nintendo Switch Pro and Sony Dualshock 4 controllers.
[*] Arcade is now locked until you play one run in Story mode.
[*] All bosses in Boss Rush now have health bars!
[*] Your weapons and ammo now transfers into the final level.
[/list]

[h2]ADJUSTMENTS[/h2][list]
[*] Bob's turrets scale too hard, so we're making them easier.
[*] --> Health per wave level reduced from 1 -> 0.2
[*] --> Attack speed per level reduced from 0.01 -> 0.
[*] Max Health perk nodes amount gained increased 3 -> 4.
[*] Hitbox reduced on the player by roughly 50%. Hitbox now reaches across cockpit to each gun, leaving each wing not damageable.
[*] Crashing into enemy ships damage reduced from Half of total HP -> 10 HP
[*] Scrap Tank spawn rate increases a small amount every time it tries to spawn and doesn't spawn.
[*] Player launched Missiles really feel weak and suboptimal.
[*] --> Damage increased from Perk Level Damage -> Perk Level Damage + Half of Primary Weapon Damage
[*] --> Damage increased per Perk Level gained from 2 damage  -> 3 damage.
[*] --> Homing Missile Turn Speed increased from 2 units/sec -> 3 units/sec
[*] Laser damage perk upgrades increased per level from 3 -> 5.
[*] Time it takes to travel the final run to Zelos' ship reduced by half.
[*] You can no longer collect a speedboost mid dodge roll.
[*] Enemies no longer bounce back after the player reaches a fast enough attack speed.
[*] Missile Drones in the final level no longer strafe sideways while firing.
[/list]

[h2]BUG FIXES[/h2][list]
[*] Fixed a bug where Scrap Tank would appear in Arcade.
[*] Fixed a bug where turrets would fire during cutscenes.
[*] Fixed a bug where Nova's arm in the Tetraknights would fire if he was dead.
[*] Fixed a bug where Aqua's arm in the Tetraknights would fire if she was dead.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Scrap Tractor Beam would not pull at an increasing speed to be collected.
[*] Fixed a bug where some of the Tetraknights would talk in the cutscene even if they were dead.
[*] Fixed a bug where the final level would have unoptimized level chunks, cutting off the player from finishing the game.
[*] Fixed a bug where ground units would "bounce back" when being hit by bullets.
[*] Fixed a bug where Tether Drones would have sorting issues.
[*] Fixed a bug where ammo count would sometimes be hidden behind game elements.
[*] Fixed a bug where some bosses would have glitched out health bars (we're looking at you, Nina).
[/list]

Thanks for all the amazing amounts of feedback and we hope this makes the game experience better!

Josh
Static City Games

notes.title: 1.0 - Out of Early Access - Full Release!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We've been looking forward to this day for a very long time! It's been an amazing 8 months, and we cannot thank you all enough for the generosity, the support, and the feedback that we've received!

Launching out of Early Access does not mean the content is stopping, we have some New Game+ ideas and possible DLC in the future for even more content!

Without further ado, here are the [b]Release v1.0 Patch Notes![/b]

[h2]ADDITIONS[/h2][list]
[*] Achievements are now live! You can login to the game to auto receive some of them based on your current save files. Good luck unlocking all 69!
[*] New Biome - "Zelos Ship Interior" - Traverse down the corridor without your ship and take out new enemies, turrets, obstacles and more!
[*] Captain Zelos now has voice / lip syncing.
[*] Tetraknight Gren and The Tetraknights both have a red warning before firing their vine attacks.
[*] Sound revamp for a lot of stuff in the game.
[*] Dialog now has a separate volume control [defaults at 100%].
[/list]

[h2]ADJUSTMENTS[/h2][list]
[*] Base Defense System guns' Health Per Level ratio reduced from 3 -> 2.1.
[*] Enemies have 10% less health after killing two bosses in a run.
[*] Enemy damage is now reduced by 32.5% after killing one boss in a run. 100% -> 67.5%
[*] Splitter Drones' spawns can now be destroyed.
[*] Captain Zelos' voice over volume reduced by 20%.
[*] Some challenges will now only show after you've unlocked the content to be able to complete that challenge.
[*] Challenge - Kill Bob without Healing Him changed from Gold to Platinum. XP/Scraps increased to 350/200.
[*] UI sound effects no longer move between ears.
[*] UI sound effects no longer sound slightly different every time they're played.
[*] The Tetraknights laser eye attack now fits the eyes better.
[*] The Tetraknights arm attacks are now in unison if Nova and Aqua haven't died that run.
[*] The Tetraknights missile burst attack is now more bursty.
[/list]

[h2]BUG FIXES[/h2][list]
[*] Fixed a large gamebreaking bug where the Static City logo would not load at the beginning of the game for AMD graphics cards, causing unknown crash to desktops.
[*] Fixed a bug whether the Tethered Drone were on the wrong sorting layer.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Splitter Drone shadows were on the wrong sorting layer after it split.
[*] Fixed a bug where missiles would be on the wrong sorting layer.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Space Base biome would disappear after killing 3 bosses.
[*] Fixed a bug where some boss ships were exploding too much.
[*] Fixed a bug where Driller Drones were sometimes not launching at the player when in range.
[*] Fixed a bug where Exploder Drones were sometimes not detonating when the player was in range.
[*] Fixed a bug where Captain Zelos' ship was not flashing on damage.
[*] Fixed a bug where sometimes the wrong music track would play.
[*] Fixed a bug where if you eliminate Nina before The Siblings join together, Nano no longer wants to fight and goes AFK.
[*] Fixed a bug where sometimes there would be invisible enemy bullets.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Player's laser would sort behind enemies.
[*] Fixed a bug where if the Co-Op player would pick up a Speedboost powerup, the game would crash.
[*] Fixed a bug where The Grid's zoom out feature would not center over the correct perk.
[*] Fixed a bug where the laser countdown timer would decrease when you were in cutscene or pause.
[*] Fixed a bug where text would overlap the dialog box during cutscenes.
[*] Fixed a bug where missiles were not playing the correct animation or sound.
[*] Fixed a bug where new game and load game screens would not translate into a new language if you changed language in the same playthrough.
[*] Fixed a bug where the game breaks if The Tetraknights are still attacking while the Player dies.
[*] Fixed some localization issues in the Challenges menu.
[*] Fixed a very annoying persistent bug where the player will sometimes go invisible for an extended period of time upon taking damage.
[/list]

Thanks again for playing our game and here's to a super amazing release week and lots of hope for the future!

Josh
Static City Games

notes.title: 0.1.1 The Bug Fix Update
notes.content:
Hey there everyone! 

Thanks so much for the amazing support, reviews, and feedback during launch week! This has been so fun and watching you all play Chronicle has been quite a humbling experience.

Here are the first ever patch notes! From here on, Chronicle's patch notes will always be on Fridays.

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[h2]ADDITIONS[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added selection sounds to in game menus.
[*] Added a "Press Start/Escape to Exit" notification in the grid for clarity.
[*] Added a quick tutorial in Story Mode for which button shoots your primary weapon for clarity.
[*] Added an error sound to The Grid when you are unable to buy something.
[*] The total scraps amount number now turns red when you cannot buy a selected node.
[*] Added a Missile Powerup for the player.
----> Requires the Missiles: Unlock node.
----> Missiles can also be upgraded to be Homing Missiles.
[/list]
[h2]ADJUSTMENTS[/h2]
[list]
[*] Localization updated for two text entries.
[*] Removed pointer arrows from any center aligned menu buttons because it looked horrible.
[*] Scraps descent speed reduced from 1.35 units/sec -> 1.15 units/sec
[*] Reduced scaling movement speed for all enemies after killing a boss from 100% -> 5%.
[*] Reduced scaling attack speed for all enemies after killing a boss from 100% -> 10%.
[/list]
[h2]FIXES[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where Operator 27 was too small in Story Mode.
[*] Fixed a bug where Alt-Tabbing out of the game and then coming back to it doesn't allow you to select anything.
[*] Fixed a bug where you were able to unlock nodes without being a high enough ship level.
[*] Fixed a bug where some locked nodes would not be unlockable after reaching them.
[*] Fixed a visual issue where some text would change font when they totally don't need to be different.
[*] Fixed a bug where the arcade upgrade screen would show if you died when killing the boss.
[/list]
Thanks so much and we'll see you again on [b]Friday [/b]for more updates!

Josh
Static City Games
